chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad al-Barqī, from his father, from al-Ṣaffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Barqī, from Ismāʿīl, from ʿUmar ibn Ḥanẓalah, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: What is permissible for a man from a menstruating woman? He said: What is between the thighs.

key_terms.لِلرَّجُلِ: for the man; what is lawful or allowed for him

ai.seo_question: What is permissible for a husband with his wife when she is menstruating according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling concerning what is permitted in intimacy with a menstruating woman. It presents a concise fiqh-based answer from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام defining the prohibited area in this context.
